crossRefs.note: By faith, Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, even concerning things to come.
The fig tree ripens her green figs. The vines are in blossom. They give out their fragrance. Arise, my love, my…
Your lips, my bride, drip like the honeycomb. Honey and milk are under your tongue. The smell of your garments is like…
Let’s go early up to the vineyards. Let’s see whether the vine has budded, its blossom is open, and the pomegranates…
The mandrakes produce fragrance. At our doors are all kinds of precious fruits, new and old, which I have stored up for…
His branches will spread, and his beauty will be like the olive tree, and his fragrance like Lebanon.
Men will dwell in his shade. They will revive like the grain, and blossom like the vine. Their fragrance will be like…
Isaac sowed in that land, and reaped in the same year one hundred times what he planted. Yahweh blessed him.
For the land which has drunk the rain that comes often on it and produces a crop suitable for them for whose sake it is…

translations.web: He came near, and kissed him. He smelled the smell of his clothing, and blessed him, and said, “Behold, the smell of my son is as the smell of a field which Yahweh has blessed.
translations.bsb: So he came near and kissed him. When Isaac smelled his clothing, he blessed him and said: “Ah, the smell of my son is like the smell of a field that the LORD has blessed.
translations.kjv: And he came near, and kissed him: and he smelled the smell of his raiment, and blessed him, and said, See, the smell of my son is as the smell of a field which the LORD hath blessed:
translations.asv: And he came near, and kissed him. And he smelled the smell of his raiment, and blessed him, and said, See, the smell of my son Is as the smell of a field which Jehovah hath blessed.
